title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-06
source: 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips(Recorded By Bear on a Sony 770 Reel 2 Reel)- 1st Generation Cassettes (TDK SAX-100's) Transferred By Dick Latvala(Master Reel Playback on a Technics 1506 Reel 2 Reel-Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck No Dolby); Analog to Digital Transfer(Cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon-Sony PCM-R500 DAT @ 44.1KHz by Jim Wise circa late 1990's) Zero Gen DAT play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Out @ 16/44.1kHz-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV @ 16/44.1KHz; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-Mastering & Processing(iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name); Jim Wise

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a relaxed Fillmore West set highlighted by a smoking Alligator jam, Lovelight organ showcase and superb drumming.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean, low‑hiss soundboard upgrade that sounds magnificent throughout. Musically the band stretches out into unique grooves – the Alligator jam, The Dew, Not Fade Away and a tight Dancin' flow effortlessly, with Pigpen’s organ work on Lovelight getting special praise. Overall the performance feels relaxed yet inspired, making this a standout show.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently highlight superb drumming and sound quality plus strong performances; weighted average of high show (≈4.5) and excellent recording (5) yields ~4.6.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeably less hiss than previous versions, crisp and magnificent sound throughout with no degradation reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed Fillmore West vibe lets the band stretch out; jams segue smoothly, especially after Dancin' leading into a smoking Alligator jam.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ work praised – his rap on Lovelight sounds like Janis Joplin and the organ plug-in is highlighted.
